name: Dress shirt
_about: the dress shirt (the collar sewn on from the 1920s): white or pale blue cotton poplin, a turned-down collar on a stand, buttoned all down the front, long sleeves with buttoned cuffs, TUCKED into the trousers or the skirt (layer 0) -- worn open at the throat, or closed under a tie; a woman's blouse is cut the same
